sources: EFSA, NIH-ODS, EMA/HMPC, Examine, Cochrane, MSK About Herbs
disclaimer_es: Dosis educativas basadas en literatura. No sustituye criterio clínico.
disclaimer_en: Educational doses based on literature. Not a substitute for clinical judgment.

items.name: Omega-3 (EPA/DHA)
items.form_es: Aceite de pescado (TG o éster etílico)
items.notes_es: Reduce TG 20–30% con 2–4 g/día. Elegir ratio EPA:DHA según objetivo (EPA→TG/ánimo).
items.notes_en: Lowers TG 20–30% at 2–4 g/day. Pick EPA:DHA ratio by goal (EPA→TG/mood).
items.reference: Welty FK Omega-3 fatty acids and cognitive function. Curr Opin Lipidol 2023. PMID 36637075

items.name: Vitamina D3
items.notes_es: Objetivo 25-OH-D 30–50 ng/mL. Cofactores: magnesio y K2.
items.notes_en: Target 25-OH-D 30–50 ng/mL. Cofactors: magnesium and K2.
items.reference: Zhang Y et al. Association between vitamin D supplementation and mortality: systematic review and meta-analysis. BMJ 2019. PMID 31405892

items.name: Magnesio
items.notes_es: Óxido tiene baja absorción; glicinato mejor tolerado. Citrato si estreñimiento.
items.notes_en: Oxide poorly absorbed; glycinate best tolerated. Citrate if constipation.

safety.separate_from_es: Separar 2–4 h de antibióticos (quinolonas/tetraciclinas) y bifosfonatos.
safety.separate_from_en: Separate 2–4 h from antibiotics (quinolones/tetracyclines) and bisphosphonates.

items.reference: Mah J et al. Oral magnesium supplementation for insomnia in older adults: a Systematic Review & Meta-Analysis. BMC Complement Med Ther 2021. PMID 33865376

items.name: Berberina
items.notes_es: Baja HbA1c ~0.7–1%. Efecto tipo metformina. GI si dosis única alta → repartir.
items.notes_en: Lowers HbA1c ~0.7–1%. Metformin-like. GI upset if single high dose → split.
items.reference: Asbaghi O et al. The effect of berberine supplementation on obesity parameters, inflammation and liver function enzymes: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Clin Nutr ESPEN 2020. PMID 32690176

items.name: Curcumina
items.interactions_es: Anticoagulantes; sustratos CYP; suspender antes de cirugía
items.interactions_en: Anticoagulants; CYP substrates; stop before surgery
items.notes_es: Baja biodisponibilidad → usar piperina, fitosoma o nanoemulsión.
items.notes_en: Low bioavailability → use piperine, phytosome or nanoemulsion.
items.reference: Zeng L et al. Efficacy and Safety of Curcumin and Curcuma longa Extract in the Treatment of Arthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trial. Front Immunol 2022. PMID 35935936

items.name: Coenzima Q10
items.notes_es: Ubiquinol mejor absorbido >50 años. Útil en mialgia por estatinas.
items.notes_en: Ubiquinol better absorbed >50 y. Useful for statin myalgia.
items.reference: Mitsui J et al. High-dose ubiquinol supplementation in multiple-system atrophy: a multicentre, randomised, double-blinded, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial. EClinicalMedicine 2023. PMID 37256098

items.name: Creatina
items.notes_es: Fuerza/masa y cognición. Monohidrato es el estándar de oro. Hidratación.
items.notes_en: Strength/mass and cognition. Monohydrate is gold standard. Hydrate.
items.reference: Xu C et al. The effects of creatine supplementation on cognitive function in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Front Nutr 2024. PMID 39070254

items.name: Melatonina
items.notes_es: Dosis baja suele bastar; más no es mejor. Cronobiótico (regula fase).
items.notes_en: Low dose usually enough; more isn't better. Chronobiotic (phase-shifts).
items.reference: Fatemeh G et al. Effect of melatonin supplementation on sleep quality: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. J Neurol 2022. PMID 33417003

items.name: Zinc
items.notes_es: >40 mg/día crónico → añadir 1–2 mg cobre. Absorción compite con hierro.
items.notes_en: >40 mg/day chronic → add 1–2 mg copper. Absorption competes with iron.

safety.separate_from_es: Separar 2 h de quinolonas y del hierro.
safety.separate_from_en: Separate 2 h from quinolones and iron.

items.reference: Ali AA et al. Zinc supplementation for acute and persistent watery diarrhoea in children: A systematic review and meta-analysis. J Glob Health 2024. PMID 39641338

items.name: Vitamina C
items.notes_es: Mejora absorción de hierro no-hemo. Repartir mejora tolerancia.
items.notes_en: Improves non-heme iron absorption. Splitting improves tolerance.

safety.oncology_caution_es: Dosis altas antioxidantes pueden interferir con radio/quimio pro-oxidante — separar del ciclo.
safety.oncology_caution_en: High antioxidant doses may blunt pro-oxidant chemo/radiotherapy — separate from cycle.

items.reference: Hemilä H et al. Vitamin C for preventing and treating the common cold. Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2013. PMID 23440782

items.name: Vitamina B12
items.notes_es: Sublingual o IM si malabsorción. Verificar con ácido metilmalónico.
items.notes_en: Sublingual or IM if malabsorption. Confirm with methylmalonic acid.
items.reference: Markun S et al. Effects of Vitamin B12 Supplementation on Cognitive Function, Depressive Symptoms, and Fatigue: A Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Meta-Regression. Nutrients 2021. PMID 33809274

items.name: Folato (B9)
items.notes_es: En MTHFR C677T preferir metilfolato. No enmascarar déficit de B12.
items.notes_en: In MTHFR C677T prefer methylfolate. Don't mask B12 deficiency.
items.reference: De-Regil LM et al. Effects and safety of periconceptional oral folate supplementation for preventing birth defects. Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2015. PMID 26662928

items.name: Hierro
items.timing_es: En ayunas + vit C; días alternos
items.interactions_es: Separar de calcio, café, té, IBP, levotiroxina
items.interactions_en: Separate from calcium, coffee, tea, PPIs, levothyroxine
items.notes_es: Días alternos mejora absorción y tolerancia. Confirmar con ferritina.
items.notes_en: Alternate-day dosing improves absorption/tolerance. Confirm with ferritin.

safety.separate_from_es: Separar 4 h de levotiroxina, calcio, café/té y quinolonas.
safety.separate_from_en: Separate 4 h from levothyroxine, calcium, coffee/tea and quinolones.

items.reference: Leung AKC et al. Iron Deficiency Anemia: An Updated Review. Curr Pediatr Rev 2024. PMID 37497686

items.name: Calcio
items.timing_es: Citrato cualquier hora; carbonato con comida
items.interactions_es: Reduce absorción de hierro, zinc, levotiroxina, quinolonas
items.interactions_en: Reduces iron, zinc, levothyroxine, quinolone absorption
items.notes_es: Fraccionar ≤500 mg. Acompañar de vit D y K2.
items.notes_en: Split ≤500 mg. Pair with vit D and K2.

safety.separate_from_es: Separar 4 h de levotiroxina, hierro y quinolonas/tetraciclinas.
safety.separate_from_en: Separate 4 h from levothyroxine, iron and quinolones/tetracyclines.

items.reference: Wright D et al. Calcium supplementation for the prevention of pre-eclampsia: Challenging the evidence from meta-analyses. BJOG 2024. PMID 38302677

items.name: Vitamina K2 (MK-7)
items.notes_es: Dirige el calcio al hueso. Sinergia con D3.
items.notes_en: Directs calcium to bone. Synergy with D3.
items.reference: Knapen MH et al. Three-year low-dose menaquinone-7 supplementation helps decrease bone loss in healthy postmenopausal women. Osteoporos Int 2013. PMID 23525894

items.name: Ashwagandha
items.notes_es: Reduce cortisol y ansiedad. Precaución en hipertiroidismo y embarazo.
items.notes_en: Lowers cortisol and anxiety. Caution in hyperthyroidism and pregnancy.
items.reference: Akhgarjand C et al. Does Ashwagandha supplementation have a beneficial effect on the management of anxiety and stress? A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Phytother Res 2022. PMID 36017529

items.name: Rhodiola rosea
items.notes_es: Anti-fatiga y rendimiento cognitivo bajo estrés. Puede activar → evitar noche.
items.notes_en: Anti-fatigue and cognition under stress. May be activating → avoid at night.
items.reference: Sarris J et al. Clinician guidelines for the treatment of psychiatric disorders with nutraceuticals and phytoceuticals: The World Federation of Societies of Biological Psychiatry (WFSBP) and Canadian Network for Mood and Anxiety Treatments (CANMAT) Taskforce. World J Biol Psychiatry 2022. PMID 35311615

items.name: Probióticos
items.notes_es: Efecto es CEPA-específico: elegir cepa según indicación, no 'genérico'.
items.notes_en: Effect is STRAIN-specific: choose strain by indication, not 'generic'.
items.reference: Dimidi E et al. British Dietetic Association Guidelines for the Dietary Management of Chronic Constipation in Adults. J Hum Nutr Diet 2025. PMID 41081513

items.name: Psyllium (fibra)
items.timing_es: Con agua abundante, antes de comidas
items.timing_en: With plenty of water, before meals
items.notes_es: Baja LDL y glucosa posprandial. Subir dosis gradual (gases).
items.notes_en: Lowers LDL and postprandial glucose. Titrate up gradually (gas).

safety.separate_from_es: Separar 2–4 h de cualquier fármaco (reduce absorción).
safety.separate_from_en: Separate 2–4 h from any drug (reduces absorption).

items.reference: van der Schoot A et al. The Effect of Fiber Supplementation on Chronic Constipation in Adults: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials. Am J Clin Nutr 2022. PMID 35816465

items.name: N-acetilcisteína (NAC)
items.notes_es: Precursor de glutatión. Antioxidante; útil en hígado y respiratorio.
items.notes_en: Glutathione precursor. Antioxidant; useful for liver and respiratory.

safety.oncology_caution_es: Antioxidante: puede interferir con quimio pro-oxidante — supervisión oncológica.
safety.oncology_caution_en: Antioxidant: may interfere with pro-oxidant chemo — oncology supervision.

items.reference: Kumar P et al. Supplementing Glycine and N-Acetylcysteine (GlyNAC) in Older Adults Improves Glutathione Deficiency, Oxidative Stress, Mitochondrial Dysfunction, Inflammation, Physical Function, and Aging Hallmarks: A Randomized Clinical Trial. J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci 2023. PMID 35975308

items.name: Ácido alfa-lipoico
items.notes_es: R-ALA más biodisponible. Mejora sensibilidad a insulina y neuropatía.
items.notes_en: R-ALA more bioavailable. Improves insulin sensitivity and neuropathy.
items.reference: An P et al. Micronutrient Supplementation to Reduce Cardiovascular Risk. J Am Coll Cardiol 2022. PMID 36480969

items.name: Quercetina
items.notes_es: Antiinflamatorio/antihistamínico natural. Baja biodisponibilidad.
items.notes_en: Natural anti-inflammatory/antihistamine. Low bioavailability.
items.reference: An P et al. Micronutrient Supplementation to Reduce Cardiovascular Risk. J Am Coll Cardiol 2022. PMID 36480969

items.name: Resveratrol
items.upper_limit: No establecido; GI a dosis altas
items.notes_es: Activador de SIRT1 in vitro; evidencia humana modesta. Trans- es la forma activa.
items.notes_en: SIRT1 activator in vitro; modest human evidence. Trans- is the active form.
items.reference: Mahjabeen W et al. Role of resveratrol supplementation in regulation of glucose hemostasis, inflammation and oxidative stress in patients with diabetes mellitus type 2: A randomized, placebo-controlled trial. Complement Ther Med 2022. PMID 35240291

items.name: EGCG (té verde)
items.interactions_es: Hepatotóxico en ayunas a dosis altas; reduce hierro
items.interactions_en: Hepatotoxic fasting at high dose; reduces iron
items.notes_es: Tomar CON comida. Vigilar transaminasas si dosis alta prolongada.
items.notes_en: Take WITH food. Monitor transaminases if prolonged high dose.
items.reference: Chen IJ et al. Therapeutic effect of high-dose green tea extract on weight reduction: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial. Clin Nutr 2016. PMID 26093535

items.name: Cardo mariano (silimarina)
items.notes_es: Hepatoprotector antioxidante. Evidencia mixta pero buen perfil de seguridad.
items.notes_en: Antioxidant hepatoprotector. Mixed evidence but good safety.
items.reference: Soleimani V et al. Safety and toxicity of silymarin, the major constituent of milk thistle extract: An updated review. Phytother Res 2019. PMID 31069872

items.name: Saw palmetto
items.notes_es: Síntomas de HPB; evidencia inconsistente. Puede alterar PSA.
items.notes_en: BPH symptoms; inconsistent evidence. May alter PSA.
items.reference: York K et al. A review of the treatment of male pattern hair loss. Expert Opin Pharmacother 2020. PMID 32066284

items.name: Ginkgo biloba
items.interactions_es: Alto riesgo con anticoagulantes/antiplaquetarios; suspender 7–10 d antes de cirugía
items.interactions_en: High risk with anticoagulants/antiplatelets; stop 7–10 d before surgery
items.notes_es: Antiagregante: ¡cuidado con warfarina! Sangrado documentado.
items.notes_en: Antiplatelet: caution with warfarin! Documented bleeding.
items.reference: Diamond BJ et al. Ginkgo biloba: indications, mechanisms, and safety. Psychiatr Clin North Am 2013. PMID 23538078

items.name: Ginseng (Panax)
items.notes_es: Puede bajar glucosa. Activador → evitar noche. Ciclar uso.
items.notes_en: May lower glucose. Activating → avoid at night. Cycle use.
items.reference: Heymsfield SB et al. Effect of Bimagrumab vs Placebo on Body Fat Mass Among Adults With Type 2 Diabetes and Obesity: A Phase 2 Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA Netw Open 2021. PMID 33439265

items.name: Ajo (alicina)
items.interactions_es: Anticoagulantes/antiplaquetarios; suspender 7–10 d antes de cirugía; antirretrovirales
items.interactions_en: Anticoagulants/antiplatelets; stop 7–10 d before surgery; antiretrovirals
items.notes_es: Baja PA levemente y lípidos. Efecto antiplaquetario relevante en cirugía.
items.notes_en: Mild BP and lipid reduction. Antiplatelet effect relevant for surgery.
items.reference: Laffin LJ et al. Comparative Effects of Low-Dose Rosuvastatin, Placebo, and Dietary Supplements on Lipids and Inflammatory Biomarkers. J Am Coll Cardiol 2023. PMID 36351465

items.name: Canela (Ceylan)
items.notes_es: Usar Ceylán para evitar cumarina. Efecto glucémico modesto.
items.notes_en: Use Ceylon to avoid coumarin. Modest glycemic effect.
items.reference: Moridpour AH et al. The effect of cinnamon supplementation on glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: An updated systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Phytother Res 2024. PMID 37818728

items.name: Cromo (picolinato)
items.notes_es: Puede mejorar sensibilidad a insulina; evidencia heterogénea.
items.notes_en: May improve insulin sensitivity; heterogeneous evidence.
items.reference: Alesi S et al. Nutritional Supplements and Complementary Therapies in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome. Adv Nutr 2022. PMID 34970669

items.name: Mio-inositol
items.notes_es: SOP: mejora ovulación y resistencia a insulina. Ratio 40:1 mio:D-chiro.
items.notes_en: PCOS: improves ovulation and insulin resistance. 40:1 myo:D-chiro ratio.
items.reference: Croze ML et al. Potential role and therapeutic interests of myo-inositol in metabolic diseases. Biochimie 2013. PMID 23764390

items.name: Taurina
items.notes_es: Cardio y metabólico; buen perfil de seguridad.
items.notes_en: Cardio and metabolic; good safety profile.
items.reference: McPheeters M et al. Pharmacotherapy for Alcohol Use Disorder: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. JAMA 2023. PMID 37934220

items.name: Glicina
items.notes_es: Mejora calidad del sueño y sensibilidad a insulina.
items.notes_en: Improves sleep quality and insulin sensitivity.
items.reference: Kumar P et al. Supplementing Glycine and N-Acetylcysteine (GlyNAC) in Older Adults Improves Glutathione Deficiency, Oxidative Stress, Mitochondrial Dysfunction, Inflammation, Physical Function, and Aging Hallmarks: A Randomized Clinical Trial. J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci 2023. PMID 35975308

items.name: L-teanina
items.notes_es: Calma sin sedación. Sinergia con cafeína para foco.
items.notes_en: Calm without sedation. Synergy with caffeine for focus.
items.reference: Hidese S et al. Effects of L-Theanine Administration on Stress-Related Symptoms and Cognitive Functions in Healthy Adults: A Randomized Controlled Trial. Nutrients 2019. PMID 31623400

items.name: 5-HTP
items.notes_es: NO combinar con antidepresivos serotoninérgicos. Empezar bajo.
items.notes_en: Do NOT combine with serotonergic antidepressants. Start low.
items.reference: Turner EH et al. Serotonin a la carte: supplementation with the serotonin precursor 5-hydroxytryptophan. Pharmacol Ther 2006. PMID 16023217

items.name: SAMe
items.notes_es: Ánimo y articulaciones. Precaución en trastorno bipolar.
items.notes_en: Mood and joints. Caution in bipolar disorder.
items.reference: Echols JC et al. SAMe (S-adenosylmethionine). Harv Rev Psychiatry 2000. PMID 10902097

items.name: Glucosamina
items.notes_es: Sulfato > HCl en evidencia. Efecto lento (semanas).
items.notes_en: Sulfate > HCl in evidence. Slow onset (weeks).
items.reference: Lugo JP et al. Efficacy and tolerability of an undenatured type II collagen supplement in modulating knee osteoarthritis symptoms: a multicenter randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study. Nutr J 2016. PMID 26822714

items.name: Colágeno (péptidos)
items.notes_es: Piel/articulaciones a 10–15 g. Tendón: 15 g + vit C antes de cargar.
items.notes_en: Skin/joints at 10–15 g. Tendon: 15 g + vit C before loading.
items.reference: Khatri M et al. The effects of collagen peptide supplementation on body composition, collagen synthesis, and recovery from joint injury and exercise: a systematic review. Amino Acids 2021. PMID 34491424

items.name: Vitamina E
items.notes_es: Dosis altas aisladas pueden ser perjudiciales; preferir mezcla natural.
items.notes_en: High isolated doses may be harmful; prefer natural mixed form.
items.reference: Xiong Z et al. Vitamin E and Multiple Health Outcomes: An Umbrella Review of Meta-Analyses. Nutrients 2023. PMID 37571239

items.name: Selenio
items.interactions_en: Narrow margin: do not exceed UL
items.notes_es: Útil en tiroiditis de Hashimoto. Tóxico por encima del UL.
items.notes_en: Useful in Hashimoto's thyroiditis. Toxic above UL.
items.reference: Huwiler VV et al. Selenium Supplementation in Patients with Hashimoto Thyroiditis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Clinical Trials. Thyroid 2024. PMID 38243784

items.name: Yodo
items.interactions_en: Antithyroid drugs; may trigger thyroid dysfunction
items.notes_es: Exceso tan dañino como déficit. Cuidado con algas no dosificadas.
items.notes_en: Excess as harmful as deficiency. Beware undosed kelp.
items.reference: Pötsch N et al. Contrast-enhanced Mammography versus Contrast-enhanced Breast MRI: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. Radiology 2022. PMID 36154284

items.name: Potasio
items.notes_es: Preferir dieta. Suplementar solo con control (arritmias).
items.notes_en: Prefer diet. Supplement only with monitoring (arrhythmia).
items.reference: Filippini T et al. Potassium Intake and Blood Pressure: A Dose-Response Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials. J Am Heart Assoc 2020. PMID 32500831

items.name: Vitamina A
items.notes_es: Betacaroteno más seguro (sin toxicidad aguda). Retinol: no exceder UL en embarazo.
items.notes_en: Beta-carotene safer (no acute toxicity). Retinol: don't exceed UL in pregnancy.

safety.note_es: Retinol teratógeno: no exceder en embarazo.
safety.note_en: Retinol is teratogenic: don't exceed in pregnancy.

items.reference: Dhaliwal S et al. Prospective, randomized, double-blind assessment of topical bakuchiol and retinol for facial photoageing. Br J Dermatol 2019. PMID 29947134

items.name: Vitamina B1 (tiamina)
items.notes_es: Benfotiamina (liposoluble) mejor en neuropatía. Déficit común en alcoholismo.
items.notes_en: Benfotiamine (fat-soluble) better for neuropathy. Deficiency common in alcoholism.
items.reference: Berger MM et al. ESPEN micronutrient guideline. Clin Nutr 2022. PMID 35365361

items.name: Vitamina B2 (riboflavina)
items.notes_es: 400 mg/día reduce frecuencia de migraña (efecto a 3 meses). Orina amarilla fluor.
items.notes_en: 400 mg/day reduces migraine frequency (effect at 3 months). Bright yellow urine.
items.reference: Berger MM et al. ESPEN micronutrient guideline. Clin Nutr 2022. PMID 35365361

items.name: Vitamina B3 (niacina)
items.notes_es: Niacina sube HDL/baja Lp(a) pero causa flushing; vigilar hígado y glucosa.
items.notes_en: Niacin raises HDL/lowers Lp(a) but causes flushing; monitor liver and glucose.
items.reference: Berger MM et al. ESPEN micronutrient guideline. Clin Nutr 2022. PMID 35365361

items.name: Vitamina B6 (piridoxina)
items.notes_es: No exceder crónicamente: neuropatía sensitiva por exceso. P5P forma activa.
items.notes_en: Don't exceed chronically: sensory neuropathy from excess. P5P is active form.
items.reference: Jayawardena R et al. The effects of pyridoxine (vitamin B6) supplementation in nausea and vomiting during pregnancy: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Arch Gynecol Obstet 2023. PMID 36719452

items.name: Biotina (B7)
items.interactions_es: INTERFIERE en análisis de laboratorio (tiroides, troponina)
items.notes_es: Suspender 48–72 h antes de análisis de sangre (falsea resultados).
items.notes_en: Stop 48–72 h before blood tests (skews results).

safety.note_es: Suspender 48–72 h antes de análisis de sangre (falsea resultados).
safety.note_en: Stop 48–72 h before blood tests (skews results).

items.reference: Berger MM et al. ESPEN micronutrient guideline. Clin Nutr 2022. PMID 35365361

items.name: Colina
items.notes_es: Alfa-GPC y citicolina para cognición. Exceso → olor corporal a pescado (TMAO).
items.notes_en: Alpha-GPC and citicoline for cognition. Excess → fishy body odor (TMAO).
items.reference: Derbyshire EJ Choline in Pregnancy and Lactation: Essential Knowledge for Clinical Practice. Nutrients 2025. PMID 40362867

items.name: Cobre
items.notes_es: Añadir si tomas zinc alto crónico. Ratio zinc:cobre ~10:1.
items.notes_en: Add if on chronic high zinc. Zinc:copper ratio ~10:1.
items.reference: Schilsky ML et al. Trientine tetrahydrochloride versus penicillamine for maintenance therapy in Wilson disease (CHELATE): a randomised, open-label, non-inferiority, phase 3 trial. Lancet Gastroenterol Hepatol 2022. PMID 36183738

items.name: Manganeso
items.notes_es: Rara vez deficitario (abundante en dieta). No exceder UL.
items.notes_en: Rarely deficient (abundant in diet). Don't exceed UL.
items.reference: Berger MM et al. ESPEN micronutrient guideline. Clin Nutr 2022. PMID 35365361

items.name: Boro
items.notes_es: Modula vitamina D, magnesio y hormonas esteroideas. Dosis baja.
items.notes_en: Modulates vitamin D, magnesium and steroid hormones. Low dose.
items.reference: Kaye KS et al. Effect of Meropenem-Vaborbactam vs Piperacillin-Tazobactam on Clinical Cure or Improvement and Microbial Eradication in Complicated Urinary Tract Infection: The TANGO I Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2018. PMID 29486041

items.name: Betaína (TMG)
items.notes_es: Baja homocisteína (sinergia con B12/folato). Puede subir LDL a dosis altas.
items.notes_en: Lowers homocysteine (synergy with B12/folate). May raise LDL at high doses.
items.reference: Aguinaga-Ontoso I et al. Effects of Nutrition Interventions on Athletic Performance in Soccer Players: A Systematic Review. Life (Basel) 2023. PMID 37374054

items.name: Beta-alanina
items.notes_es: Sube carnosina muscular; mejora esfuerzos 1–4 min. Hormigueo (inofensivo) → repartir.
items.notes_en: Raises muscle carnosine; improves 1–4 min efforts. Tingling (harmless) → split.
items.reference: Saunders B et al. β-alanine supplementation to improve exercise capacity and performance: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Br J Sports Med 2017. PMID 27797728

items.name: L-citrulina
items.notes_es: Sube óxido nítrico (mejor que arginina oral). Flujo sanguíneo y bomba.
items.notes_en: Raises nitric oxide (better than oral arginine). Blood flow and pump.
items.reference: An P et al. Micronutrient Supplementation to Reduce Cardiovascular Risk. J Am Coll Cardiol 2022. PMID 36480969

items.name: L-carnitina
items.notes_es: ALCAR cruza BHE (cognición); tartrato para recuperación. TMAO en exceso.
items.notes_en: ALCAR crosses BBB (cognition); tartrate for recovery. TMAO in excess.
items.reference: Talenezhad N et al. Effects of l-carnitine supplementation on weight loss and body composition: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 37 randomized controlled clinical trials with dose-response analysis. Clin Nutr ESPEN 2020. PMID 32359762

items.name: L-tirosina
items.notes_es: Precursor de dopamina/noradrenalina; útil bajo estrés/privación de sueño.
items.notes_en: Dopamine/noradrenaline precursor; useful under stress/sleep loss.
items.reference: Hup RJ et al. Oral antihypertensive treatment during pregnancy: a systematic review and network meta-analysis. Am J Obstet Gynecol 2025. PMID 40216176

items.name: Bacopa monnieri
items.notes_es: Mejora memoria a 8–12 semanas (efecto lento). Puede dar molestia GI.
items.notes_en: Improves memory at 8–12 weeks (slow onset). May cause GI upset.
items.reference: Calabrese C et al. Effects of a standardized Bacopa monnieri extract on cognitive performance, anxiety, and depression in the elderly: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. J Altern Complement Med 2008. PMID 18611150

items.name: Melena de león
items.notes_es: NGF/neurogénesis in vitro; evidencia humana emergente. Buscar cuerpo fructífero.
items.notes_en: NGF/neurogenesis in vitro; emerging human evidence. Seek fruiting body.
items.reference: Docherty S et al. The Acute and Chronic Effects of Lion's Mane Mushroom Supplementation on Cognitive Function, Stress and Mood in Young Adults: A Double-Blind, Parallel Groups, Pilot Study. Nutrients 2023. PMID 38004235

items.name: Cordyceps

items.name: Astaxantina
items.notes_es: Antioxidante potente; fotoprotección de piel. Liposoluble.

safety.oncology_caution_en: Potent antioxidant: consult oncologist during chemo/radiotherapy.

items.name: PQQ
